page_title: BIL 1-0 PAL | Athletic Bilbao v Las Palmas 20/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Juan Martinez Munuera is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) was quite harsh and Juan Martinez Munuera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

90+4' 1 - 0 Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) attempts to convert a rebound into a goal with a header from outside the box. He manages to surprise the defence and changes the score to 1:0 after striking the ball into the bottom left corner.
90+3' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but Alvaro Valles comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+1' The substitution is prepared. Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Munir El Haddadi.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
86' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decides to make a substitution. Nico Williams will be replaced by Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao).
86' Substitution. Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) in, Benat Prados Diaz out.
85' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough challenge and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
82' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
82' Referee Juan Martinez Munuera signals NO PENALTY for Ath Bilbao after a VAR review!

82' There's a break in play and referee Juan Martinez Munuera must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Ath Bilbao using VAR. This could be interesting!
81' Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
80' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

80' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
79' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Omenuke Mfulu (Las Palmas) comes onto the pitch for Marvin.
76' The total number of attempts is 12:5.
74' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Alvaro Valles is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
72' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
72' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
71' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. It will be a corner kick for Ath Bilbao.
70' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao). Ath Bilbao get a corner.

69' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Alvaro Valles easily catches the ball.
68' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
68' Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
68' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Unai Simon thwarts him with a nice save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Las Palmas.
66' Here is a change. Oihan Sancet is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is coming onto the pitch as Sory Kaba cannot continue after picking up an injury.
58' The corner is swung in but Ath Bilbao can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

57' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save. The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
56' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to make a change. Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) replaces Gorka Guruzeta.
56' The manager makes a subsitution with Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) coming on for Ander Herrera.
53' Juan Martinez Munuera has a clear sight and sees a foul from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao).
51' Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
48' Ath Bilbao hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+5' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
45+3' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
42' Good chance! Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
41' Marvin (Las Palmas) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
41' Marvin (Las Palmas) picks up an injury.

40' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot inside the left post. Alvaro Valles anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
40' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
39' Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
39' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) is penalised for holding. Juan Martinez Munuera signals a set piece. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Ath Bilbao!
37' The ball possession at the moment is 44:56.
35' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
32' The Las Palmas players are stunned as referee Juan Martinez Munuera changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
29' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Las Palmas as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.

28' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Juan Martinez Munuera saw the whole situation. It's a penalty! Las Palmas have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
27' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
25' Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
24' A cross from a corner kick by Las Palmas is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
23' Marvin (Las Palmas) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Las Palmas.
21' Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) attempts to put the ball in from a rebound with his long-range shot, but it isn't accurate enough, and the ball goes high over the crossbar.
19' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.

14' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) produced a promising shot towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Alvaro Valles thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
14' Marvin (Las Palmas) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Unai Simon intercepts the ball.
10' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
3' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Las Palmas will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Juan Martinez Munuera.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
